name: Employees above 8000
question: Show employees earning more than 8000 INR per month.
sql: SELECT id, name, salary, department FROM employees WHERE salary > :threshold ORDER BY id

name: Keep the threshold, only IT
question: Only those in IT.
sql: SELECT id, name, salary, department FROM employees WHERE salary > :threshold AND department = :department ORDER BY id

name: Exactly at the boundary
question: Show the employee earning exactly 8000.
sql: SELECT id, name FROM employees WHERE salary = :threshold ORDER BY id

name: Missing salary
question: Which employee has a missing salary?
sql: SELECT id, name FROM employees WHERE salary IS NULL ORDER BY id

name: Monthly payroll by department
question: Show monthly payroll by department.
sql: SELECT department, SUM(salary) AS monthly_payroll FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY department

name: Reviewed high-earners definition
question: Show high earners, using salary above 9000 INR per month.
sql: SELECT id, name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > :threshold ORDER BY id

name: Why a joined total doubles
question: Why does the joined salary total double?
sql: SELECT SUM(e.salary) AS total FROM employees e JOIN payments p ON e.id = p.employee_id
